verses.1: The waters of the sea are under the control of the King, by the hand of Jehovah. He will bring down those who seek to rebel against Him.
verses.2: All the ways of a righteous man are pleasing to God’s eyes, and His heart rejoices.
verses.3: Do righteousness and justice. Choose to be chosen by Jehovah from among the wicked.
verses.4: The wicked have eyes that see nothing, and hearts that are wide open to evil.
verses.5: All thoughts are fleeting, and all lands are destined to be destroyed.
verses.6: The fruits of deceit and falsehood are cast aside by those who seek death.
verses.7: Evil people will be punished because they have committed wrongdoing.
verses.8: He acts in a way that is both strange and proper for a stranger.
verses.9: It is better to sit on a mat made of reeds, away from the fire of Midianites, and in the house of one’s brother.
verses.10: The wicked soul is evil and not pleasing in his eyes.
verses.11: In punishment for their foolishness, let them learn from their mistakes. And in wisdom, let them gain knowledge.
verses.12: A wise and righteous person is better than a wicked house; a wicked person is worse than filth.
verses.13: Our ears are deafened by the cries of those who beg for help. Yet he will still call out, and no one will respond to him.
verses.14: He will be sealed in the ark; he will also be punished for his evil deeds.
verses.15: Rejoice for the righteous who act with justice and who do what is right.
verses.16: Man will be led astray from the path of righteousness by those who are sick and suffering.
verses.17: A man who is bound loves joy. He loves wine and tobacco; he does not work.
verses.18: A book for the righteous and the wicked; under it, they shall be judged.
verses.19: Goodness lies in the land of the desert, away from the fire of Midianites and their anger.
verses.20: Whether it’s a wise man or a foolish one, they will all be swallowed up by the sea.
verses.21: He who pursues righteousness and kindness will find life, along with honor and prosperity.
verses.22: The city of Gibeah rose up in rebellion. A wise man came down from Bethel.
verses.23: He keeps his mouth shut, and for those who change it, he protects his soul from harm.
verses.24: Zed Yehir Lez’s name is associated with the act of fraud.
verses.25: The weight of sin will kill us, because we are unable to do anything to get rid of it.
verses.26: Today, there is anger and hatred. The righteous will give back what was taken from them, and they won’t be harmed.
verses.27: Worshiping the wicked is a disgraceful act, even though it may bring us some benefit at times.
verses.28: False witnesses will be destroyed, but those who listen to the truth will be remembered forever.
verses.29: Let a wicked man be defeated in his own eyes. Then he will understand his own ways.
verses.30: There is no wisdom, no insight, and no plan to oppose Jehovah.
verses.31: A day of peace for the time of war, and for Jehovah’s salvation.
